cards.audioText: What are the main advantages of that cockpits compared with the traditional instrument cockpits?
cards.audioTextZh: 与传统仪表驾驶舱相比，这类驾驶舱的主要优势是什么？
cards.referenceText: The main benefit is improved situational awareness. Compared with the older method, it gives pilots clearer information, better monitoring, and more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要好处是提升态势感知。与较旧的方式相比，它能给飞行员更清晰的信息、更好的监控能力，并为安全决策争取更多时间。

cards.audioText: How do multiple display screens help pilots during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 多个显示屏如何在飞行中帮助飞行员？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Modern glass cockpit. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与现代玻璃驾驶舱有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。
